envelope.note: Invalid because test_launch_correction_gate.CorrectionShape.test_out_input_under_a_review_job_is_a_correction fails for five review-job subtests. Its fixture creates each source review directory under jobs_root before dispatch, while assert_no_mint requires jobs_root to contain no directories. Deleting existing review artifacts would violate the requested gate behavior, and the test files were not edited. Git commit was also sandbox-refused; the launcher can commit using out/COMMIT_MSG.
